summary: Feed s166_triple to IDS is degraded: 3 faults found - 8.5% oversize jumbo frames dropped by 1518B NIC, 3.93 Gbps bursts overloading 1 Gbps port (393% capacity), and 21.2% VXLAN-encapsulated traffic hiding inner payload from IDS inspection.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker forwarding jumbo frames up to 8108 bytes without MTU handling to an IDS port limited to 1518 bytes. Likely VXLAN overhead or upstream jumbo MTU propagated without slicing/MTU normalization.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS NIC drops 246/2894 frames (8.5%) at hardware level before inspection. Complete blind spot for attacks using large frames; IDS needs_full_payload=true so loss is total for those flows.

recommended_fix.why: IDS requires full payload so slicing would break detection. Enable jumbo frames (MTU 9000-9216) on IDS NIC/port or normalize at broker to 1518 only if jumbo not supported - preserves payload for inspection instead of silent drop.

findings.root_cause: Aggregate/burst traffic from broker exceeds IDS port capacity. Peak 3.93 Gbps in 1ms burst vs 1 Gbps port (393% of capacity, 9 overloaded intervals) - no load balancing or filtering to fit tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS drops packets randomly during bursts due to buffer overrun. Results in missed detections, broken TCP reassembly, one-way state, and gaps in IDS coverage during peak attack windows.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute load across multiple IDS instances/ports or upgrade to 10G so sustained bursts stay below 80% utilization threshold and prevent tail drops.

findings.root_cause: 613/2894 frames (21.2%) forwarded inside VXLAN tunnel without decapsulation at packet broker. IDS receives outer VXLAN header only.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot parse inner L2-L7 payload (IP, TCP, HTTP, etc.) for 21% of traffic. Signatures and anomaly detection fail on encapsulated traffic - major detection coverage loss.

recommended_fix.why: Strip VXLAN header at broker to expose inner packets to IDS which has no tunnel decoding capability, restoring visibility for inspection.
